entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with T.R Case No.59 of 2019, pending before the Court of the learned Addl. Dist. & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act. arising out of Borigumma P.S Case No.121 of 2019 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 363/341/354/376(2)(n)/506/34 of the IPC.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned P.O.,
Special Court, under POCSO At, Jeypore, by order dated 09.05.2023 in the aforementioned case,
the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is stated that petitioner was released on bail by the learned Court in Sessions by order dated 03.01.2020 and since he did not appear on the date fixed, he was taken into custody on execution of NBW(A) 20.04.2023.
5.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner for 2 years he regularly appeared on the dated fixed and non-appearance was due to circumstance beyond this control and not willful.
6.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail during currency of investigation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the conduct of the petitioner considering the submission that will default was not willful, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

8. Additionally, it is directed that petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till submission of final form.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
9. Additionally, it is directed that one of sureties shall be immediate member of the family of the petitioner who shall execute the P.R. bond.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
